race.comment: LOVE STORY (6) was lining up for only the second time when she led all the way and thrashed a subsequent winner over this trip at the Kensington track three weeks ago. Tim Clark is likely to control the race again and this promising filly can take it the next level this afternoon. DIDDLE DUMPLING (1) was 39 days between runs and found 1200m a bit slick last time out at Rosehill. Fitter and will appreciate the extra 200m. Watch for a far better performance. CHILLI MARGS (4) settled back in the field then made nice ground to get up for third when resuming in the same race as DIDDLE DUMPLING at Rosehill recently. Has won two races and both were over today's journey second-up. Profiles nicely. LIVE (8) got too far back from a wide draw last start. Cherry ripe third-up and not out of discussions. REFLECT (3) has performed well in her two runs this prep despite tardy getaways. Very fit now and will enjoy stepping up to 1400m.
